program: Hi Code Product-Grade Desktop and Industrial Workbench

risks.title: Assistant output is not yet fully protocol-native
risks.impact: Concurrent desktop sessions can remain coupled to compatibility output capture, limiting reliable replay and SDK parity.
risks.mitigation: Implement RuntimeEventSink, assistant delta/completed events, client adapters, and concurrency tests in HC-RUN-201.
risks.trigger: Any output mixing, blank response, or transcript mismatch blocks release promotion.

risks.title: No real Electron responsive E2E baseline
risks.impact: Unit and renderer smoke tests can miss clipping, unreachable controls, window lifecycle, and preload integration regressions.
risks.mitigation: Launch packaged-development Electron with Playwright and capture 720/1024/1440 fixtures in HC-QA-101.
risks.trigger: A core action hidden without an alternative or a failed real Electron launch blocks release.

risks.title: Electron compatibility line needs an isolated supported-version upgrade
risks.impact: Runtime support and Chromium security maintenance can age before stable release.
risks.mitigation: Upgrade only after HC-QA-101 provides startup and responsive regression coverage.
risks.trigger: Unsupported Electron status or a high production/runtime advisory blocks release.

risks.title: Desktop installers are not commercially signed
risks.impact: macOS Gatekeeper or Windows SmartScreen can warn users and weaken installation trust.
risks.mitigation: Keep artifacts prerelease-only, publish checksums, and require signing identities before stable promotion.
risks.trigger: Stable release or automatic update enablement requires valid signing and platform smoke evidence.

risks.title: Industrial bridge capabilities can be overstated
risks.impact: Users could mistake plans or templates for licensed commercial-tool execution.
risks.mitigation: Preserve simulated, not_run, external_required, and manual approval evidence through UI, gates, and releases.
risks.trigger: Any bridge or dry-run result displayed as real/passed is a release blocker.

risks.title: User shell profile references a removed ComfyUI environment
risks.impact: Bash test and user-command output contains a benign startup warning that can obscure relevant diagnostics.
risks.mitigation: Repair or guard the external profile entry outside the repository; do not change project tests to hide it.
risks.trigger: If the warning changes command exit status or masks tool output, treat it as a developer-environment blocker.

risks.title: Program evidence was previously ignored or historical
risks.impact: Old issue counts or untracked pass claims could be mistaken for current release evidence.
risks.mitigation: Track program/task/evidence paths, mark old audits historical, and capture hashed command logs.
risks.trigger: A release claim without source-linked committed evidence reopens this risk.
